description:
Fetch, cache and cross-search log files from many services at once

LogLooker downloads only the log files a date range needs, caches them compressed, and searches every selected service in one merged timeline with substring or full regex queries. Results can be charted over time or ranked by category, aggregating the whole result rather than the loaded page. Where the logs come from, how they are laid out, how their lines parse and what is worth searching are described by plugins - one JSON file each, no code. Two ship with the app: a local folder reader that needs no credentials, and an Azure App Service reader that authenticates with the Azure CLI.
Version 1.1.14 release.
